correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the nine-state generator and independently expanded det(xI-Q-yB) through total degree two, with y=e^s-1. Implicit differentiation gives the printed stationary current and two-site Fano rational function coefficientwise. For one site the independent inter-exit times consist of an exponential entry wait plus exponential active time interrupted by a Poisson number of exponential pauses; their variance divided by squared mean gives F1. An exact positive-variable substitution u=v/[10(1+v)] certifies all eleven comparison coefficient signs and strict positivity at k=u^2, including the u=1/10 endpoint checked separately. Descartes plus the two negative end signs gives exactly two simple positive crossings. Compact rescaling and sign brackets give the u^2 and u scales. After k=ut the rational numerator and denominator give the uniform tail bounds O(t+u) and O(t^-1+u); hence the unique interior maximum of the limiting profile controls every global maximizer for sufficiently small u. The independent replay reproduces both quartics and constants. This neither proves nor requires finite-u maximizer uniqueness.
residual_risks: Double crossing is only certified for 0<u<=1/10 and unit injection, hop and exit rates.

value.rationale: At the smallest chain lengths admitting exclusion and blocking, adding one site can either suppress or amplify output noise as pausing is varied. The universal two-reversal pattern and the separation between rare-pause and balanced-pause scales are not routine consequences of a nonmonotone curve. The exact global profile further quantifies the strongest amplification in the slow-unpausing regime.
residual_risks: No claim for general chain lengths, unequal rates or finite observation windows.
